text:
ashwin_ae: Quick heads-up — StrataBank wants a 3yr commit but needs net150 payment terms and wants to split invoicing: 30% upfront, then quarterly invoices for the remainder. They expect a 25% discount off list for the multi-year. Need deal-desk + finance approval. POC will run for 6 weeks before GA.

maria_sales_ops: tagging @rebecca_finance and @jon_dealdesk — this is above our standard net90, discount is higher than our published tiers. Can you weigh in? Also note they want invoices routed to parent corp (different bill-to).

rebecca_finance: net150 is outside standard credit policy. We'll need a full credit check, and likely a guarantee or payment instrument (ACH + proof of funds) if CFO doesn't approve extended terms. Margin impact looks like ~28% NRR hit in year 1 with the discount. Send expected ARR numbers.

ashwin_ae: ARR = $1.2M ARR first-year (post-discount), grows to $1.55M by year3. We're proposing: 30% upfront (invoice at signing), then 6 quarterly invoices in year1 (net90 each), years 2-3 invoiced annually in advance. Suggested language for SOW/schedule can be added.

jon_dealdesk: Need a short justification for the 25% concession vs. standard multi-year tier. Also need to confirm routing for split invoice (bill-to vs payer). If we accept net150 on the quarterly pieces, require an additional 5% price protection holdback until POC completes.

sam_se: FYI — POC uses 4x A100 instances for 6 weeks. Expected infra cost to us ~ $45k. We should factor that into margin calc or ask them to cover POC infra as a credit on first invoice.

maria_sales_ops: proposal summary to get approvals:
```
- Customer: StrataBank (parent: StrataHoldings)
- Term: 36 months
- List ARR: $1.6M/year
- Discount: 25% off list
- Billing: 30% upfront at signing, then quarterly invoices (net150) for remainder of year1, years2-3 annual upfront invoices
- POC: 6 weeks, infra credit $45k applied to first invoice
- Conditions: successful credit check, signed SOW, CFO signoff for net>90
```

rebecca_finance: This is doable conditionally. We need: 1) completed credit check (run overnight), 2) parent guarantee or irrevocable bank guarantee for >90 net exposure OR move to 45% upfront instead of 30%, 3) legal to confirm bill-to/payer alignment. Without guarantee, CFO likely declines.

legalbot: We need the SOW to include invoice schedule and payer entity. Also routing for tax jurisdictions (they're EU + US ops). If parent signs guarantee, we can accept multi-entity billing. Also flag: anti-money-laundering clause and export controls to be reviewed.

linda_cfo: looping in — I'm open to extended terms for strategic customers but require one of: parent guarantee, bank guarantee, or higher upfront (>=45%). If they can move to 45% upfront we can approve net120 for the remaining schedule; net150 still feels risky. Also need AR holdback mechanics documented.

ashwin_ae: I can push the increase to 45% upfront if that makes approval faster — will propose 45% upfront + bank guarantee for the rest. Customer will push back but prefers longer terms vs higher upfront.

jon_dealdesk: If customer accepts 45% upfront + bank guarantee, deal desk can approve 20% discount (not 25%). Anything below 45% upfront needs direct CFO exec waiver.

maria_sales_ops: next steps: Ashwin to confirm with StrataBank on (a) willingness to 45% upfront or provide bank guarantee, (b) payer entity and billing address, (c) acceptance of infra credit. Once confirmed, @rebecca_finance will run credit check and @legalbot will draft SOW/invoice schedule.

ashwin_ae: I'll get answers today and post back with their preference. Thanks all. :pray:

rebecca_finance: Ran preliminary credit checks (soft pull) — parent (StrataHoldings) shows adequate lines, but formal bank guarantee request will take ~7 business days.

ashwin_ae: Update from customer: they can do 45% upfront OR a bank guarantee; prefer 45% upfront to keep treasury simple. They accept 20% discount if we move to 45% upfront. Also confirmed payer is the parent entity.

jon_dealdesk: With customer agreeing to 45% upfront + 20% discount and parent as payer, deal desk grants provisional approval. Conditions: signed SOW with invoice schedule, CFO sign-off on final contract, funds receipt for upfront before provisioning.

linda_cfo: I approve contingent on receipt of 45% upfront and bank account verification. Once payment clears, grant final sign-off.

maria_sales_ops: great — I'll hand this to legal for SOW and payment terms. Closing notes for record: switched from net150 request to net120 for remainder (with upfront >45%), discount reduced to 20%, POC infra credit applied to first invoice.

ashwin_ae: Thanks team — moving to contracting. Will ping when SOW signed and payment received. :rocket:
